## [3.2.0](https://github.com/pomee4/morphe-patches/compare/v3.1.0...v3.2.0) (2026-11-25)

### ✨ New Features

* **Reddit:** Open the comment swipe settings from the Reddit settings ([46b6f94](https://github.com/pomee4/morphe-patches/commit/46b6f9400f705eee4d168e7dc0b9f602874576d3))

patches.name: Keep the playlist in car playback
patches.description: A playlist or album started from Waze, Android Auto or another media browser keeps playing that list when an audio-source extension plays it, instead of playing only the picked song and going on with its song radio.

patches.name: Comment swipe actions
patches.description: Adds swipe actions to comments: swipe a comment sideways to upvote, downvote, reply, save, share, collapse or open the author's profile, picked by how far it is swiped. Settings: Reddit settings, General, Comment swipe.
